#BTC A small amount of money vanishes fast, and the two words at the root of it are: impatience.

I have a brother who put 1500U into the market. In the first week he made 300U—right then he felt like he was the chosen one, a born trader. In the second week he went straight to maximum position sizing, his whole mind focused on: “With a small capital, I have to go in hard to turn it around.” Then a small pullback came—profits got fully given back, and he even ended up losing money. He refused to accept it, added another 1000U to get back to even… and within less than half a month he lost it all.

Later, we reviewed everything. Every trade that caused a blow-up happened when he was in a state of panic—eyes red, mind frantic—opening positions while desperately trying to double, desperately trying to break even, desperately trying to prove himself.

When people get anxious, their brains get messy. Going all-in, holding positions through losses, chasing pumps and selling dumps—these are all basic mistakes they wouldn’t normally make. He couldn’t bear to place stop-loss orders, couldn’t control his position size, couldn’t wait for signals to confirm, rushed in thinking, “This time it’s guaranteed,” and only after exiting realized that what was steady was the market—not him.

When I restarted from the remaining 400U, I set an absurdly low goal: within three months, the account wouldn’t drop below 300U. That single requirement directly kept my hands in check. No random trades, no all-in. After three months, my account quietly rolled up to over 5000U.#ETH 

The first step to growing a small account isn’t studying how to double quickly—it’s first pressing down that rush of fire. The more urgently you charge forward, the more the market makes you spit it all back—twice.

People who rush in hard end up paying the market the last of their money. Those who can stay calm and hold their nerve often touch the results first. Think it through, then come back.

No matter whether you’re losing now, confused, or can’t read the market—so long as you don’t blindly trade and you follow my rhythm, I can help you live steadily and earn slowly. We’re in the process of setting it up—those who understand are already on the train!@Square-Creator-dcf66b07985da

The key amendments include: raising the maximum prison term for unregistered financial activities from under 3 years to under 10 years, and increasing the fine from under 3 million yen to under 10 million yen; introducing crypto-asset insider-trading regulations for the first time, prohibiting trading using undisclosed material information; and requiring certain crypto-asset issuers to make regular annual disclosures.

On the taxation side, the system shifts from comprehensive taxation of up to 55% to filing-and-separately assessed taxation (tax rate around 20%), with losses carried forward for 3 years. title: 晚间市场报告：鸽派 CPI 撑到收盘，夜里多头开始遇麻烦
subTitle:
白天市场只信「6 月能源便宜」这份过期数据——可油没跌、战争在夜里升级。这份鸽派定价扛过了美股收盘，但明早 05:30 加州时间的 PPI 是第一次复核。

【一、宏观：鸽派 CPI 的涨，扛到了美股收盘】
• 6 月 CPI 全线爆冷（整体环比 -0.4%、核心环比 0%）撑起普涨，美股收盘保住：标普 +0.38%｜纳指 +0.90%｜费城半导体 +2.54%（独强，存储+芯片领涨）
• 10 年美债 4.585%（较昨收 4.609% 下行）｜VIX 16.5（-3.85%）｜加息概率 42% → 17%
• 但夜盘两个反向信号：现货金回落到 $4,036（-0.40%）、且特朗普正在筹划对伊朗更大规模的攻势

📌 白天市场只信「6 月能源便宜」这份过期数据，可油没跌、战争在夜里升级。鸽派定价扛过了收盘，明早 PPI 是第一次复核。

【二、国际形势：战争在夜里升级，不是降级】
• AXIOS（三名知情人士）：特朗普周二在白宫战情室开会，讨论对伊朗发动更大规模攻势，范围将比目前霍尔木兹周边的打击更广
• 伊朗革命卫队袭击了美军在科威特的设施，战线继续扩到海湾
• WTI 原油 $79.42（+0.33%），仍稳在 79 上方——7 月初 71 涨上来后没回去
• 高盛给出极端双向：若海湾出口复苏停滞，Q4 布伦特可能破 $110；若产量超预期、需求复苏慢，年底也可能跌到 $60

📌 供给端坏消息一整天没停，风险资产却全靠一份 6 月 CPI 撑着。断掉的是「油 → 通胀」这一环，而且很可能只是延后。油没跌 + 战在升级 = 明早 PPI 和 8 月那份 CPI 才是真审判。

【三、技术面：超买消化，趋势没破】

📌 结论不变：要做多，做 ETH，不做 BTC。

BlockBeats message: On July 15, crypto market analyst gaah cited CryptoQuant data in a post saying that the share of holdings held by long-term holders (LTH) and short-term holders (STH) of BTC has risen to a 30-month high. This metric is used to measure how Bitcoin supply is distributed between long-term and short-term holders.

The analysis indicates that extreme readings of this metric usually do not occur at the peak of market euphoria, but rather during the re-accumulation phase. Brothers and sisters! With a small amount of capital in the crypto market—learn how to stay alive first.

Many people come in with 1000U and the only thing on their mind is to turn it tenfold, twentyfold. Chasing hot trends, switching positions constantly, going all-in—after months of busy trading, you look back and realize the principal hasn’t grown; instead, you’ve lost weight. $AKE 

A while back, a follower reached out to talk with me. Their account had 1200U, and they could open a dozen-plus trades a day—full package: chasing pumps and selling dumps. After two months, they had less than 700U left, and the person was exhausted too.

Later I told them to change their mindset: don’t think about how much to make first—think about how not to lose.

They split their 1200U into four parts. Each time, they only moved 300U. Wait until the signals were something they could understand before entering. The goal wasn’t to get rich overnight. It was to turn 300U into 450U first, then slowly shift from 450U up to 700U. The pace was slower, but the account was stable. Most importantly, they would no longer be kicked out after a single mistake.

When retail traders lose money, there’s one core problem: position size is too heavy. With a small account, opening a trade becomes half position or even full position. The market moves slightly against them, and they panic. They either randomly cut or stubbornly hold—and no matter how the price goes, it ends up a loss. The people who can grow small money into big money are the ones who, before placing a trade, calculate this: if this trade loses, can I still place the next one normally? A position you can’t afford to lose—that’s an oversize position. $U 

One more thing: when you make money, learn to lock in profits. A lot of people go from 1000U to 2000U and are happy for less than three seconds. They refuse to take profits, and in the end it falls back to square one. My habit is: once profit reaches the target, take out part of it first, and let the rest keep running inside. Your mindset becomes lighter, and you’re less likely to give it all back.

Don’t rush just because you see a big bullish candle. And don’t blindly follow after seeing others post screenshots of their wins. I’ve seen too many losses, and they all happen at the moment when emotions get hot. It’s better to wait until trading volume expands and key levels truly break before acting. Entering half a beat later means slightly less profit, but your win rate is much higher. $DODOX

BarnBridge Suffers Suspected Governance Attack, Nearly $776K Lost

The BarnBridge SMART Yield (cUSDC) protocol on Ethereum has suffered a suspected governance attack, with estimated losses of approximately $776,000.

* Security firm BlockSec detected the exploit through its Phalcon monitoring system.
* The attacker allegedly gained DAO governance control and upgraded the protocol's controller to a malicious contract.
* The malicious implementation exploited existing USDC approvals from around 50 user accounts.
* Stolen funds were aggregated and transferred to the attacker's address using the protocol's privileged functions.

The incident highlights the ongoing security risks surrounding DAO governance and privileged smart contract upgrades in DeFi.

昨天ETH反弹了5%，一周涨了7%。有人觉得这是死猫跳，我不这么看。

title: If you’re new to crypto, here are a few lessons I genuinely wish I understood earlier:
subTitle:
Most beginners in crypto don’t lose because they’re stupid. VThey lose because nobody teaches them the part that actually matters.
 
When I first entered crypto, I thought success was about finding the next big coin early. But the truth is, the hardest part wasn’t finding opportunities. It was managing hype, risk, impatience, and emotion.
 
If you’re new to crypto, here are a few lessons I genuinely wish I understood earlier:
 
1. Hype is not research.
If everyone is screaming “to the moon,” that’s usually the moment to slow down, not speed up. A coin being popular doesn’t make it valuable. Always ask: what does this project actually do?
 
2. Risk management matters more than profit dreams.
At first, I only thought about how much I could make. Now I think differently: how much can I afford to lose without hurting my real life? That question protects beginners more than excitement ever will.
 
3. There’s a reason many people start with BTC and ETH.
They’re not risk-free, but they’re more established than most small coins. A lot of beginners get hurt chasing low-cap hype before they even understand the basics.
 
4. Spot, futures, and leverage are not the same game.
This is where many beginners get humbled fast. Spot is one thing. Futures and leverage are much more dangerous if you don’t fully understand what you’re doing.
 
5. Security is part of investing.
Strong passwords, 2FA, and avoiding suspicious links may sound boring, but they matter. In crypto, protecting your account is just as important as picking the right coin.
 
6. If you enter without a plan, emotions will trade for you.
Why are you buying? Are you investing, trading, or just reacting to a pump? If you don’t know your reason for entering, the market will expose that quickly.
 
7. Patience beats panic.
A lot of beginners lose money the same way: they buy from excitement and sell from fear. Crypto moves fast, but not every candle deserves your reaction.
 
If I could give one honest piece of advice to every beginner, it would be this:
 
Learn first. Start small. Stay safe. Stay consistent.
 
Crypto can be powerful, but only if you respect the risks.

But with CEX inventories jumping and extreme on-chain loss ratios, a sentiment reversal could be triggered at any moment. What you can do now is simply wait for signals—don’t fight in a knife fight over the swings around 500.

【Three Main Lines】

BTC: The whole market’s directional anchor is around 64,645 — this is the short-term lifeline. Above 65,000 is the last line of defense for shorts; only when hourly candles close up with bodies can it be considered a breakout. Below 63,500 is the accumulation zone—an effective breakdown will directly test 62,000. Two facts are true today at the same time: the rebound is driven by real taker buy pressure, and the long/short positioning ratio has hit a 30-month high. Historically, that usually appears in the phase of renewed accumulation. But Binance’s BTC inventory is surging, and the UTXO loss ratio has also reached an extreme level. This setup has only shown up previously during deep bear-market pressure periods—so chasing longs has poor risk-reward. I’ll wait for a breakout confirmation of 64,800–65,000, or wait for a daily pullback to 63,500 before acting. If 63,500 breaks, then I’ll switch to full defense.

ETH: The weakest link in the majors. In the past 12 hours, whales have added short positions around 1,858 at market price; longs are left with only passive defense at the clean 1,800 level, lacking proactive buy-side capital. Very low on-chain Gas and a shrinking level of ecosystem activity are facts. If BTC tests 65,000, ETH would at most passively follow to 1,900–1,920—I won’t chase. If it breaks below 1,855 and lacks the strength to reclaim it, ETH is the priority to avoid.

SOL: On-chain heat is clearly declining; the capital for Memes and new launches is drying up. Price is being pressed below the 80 psychological level, and long momentum is almost gone. The HYPE listing narrative has diverted most attention. If this narrative can’t keep feeding capital, SOL’s on-chain liquidity will face short-term exhaustion. Personally, I would consider allocating its ecosystem tokens only after SOL effectively holds above 80.5; for now, I’m just watching and not moving.

【Market Picks】

HYPE: Because of the contract going live before the listing, it captured short-term attention. The on-chain long/short ratio is already as high as 1.88. At this high level, profit-taking longs could escape at any time—chasing the upside has very poor value. This position is only suitable for those entering early to move the stop and take profit; it’s not a new entry moment.

BABA: Alibaba’s AI integration into the Apple China ecosystem may boost short-term sentiment. But the path to monetization is long, and the core of its real business is also constrained by macro growth. It can only be observed as a wind vane for AI deployment; I’m not entering.

Embodied AI: Fundraising in the first half was unusually hot—288 rounds, over $6.4 billion—but most of the revenue heavy lifting is still on the R&D side. Funds are very likely to flow upstream into compute power and physical AI companies. However, performance conversion lags by 2–4 quarters. Right now, it only has observation value; I won’t position on the left side.

【Not Chasing Today】
Don’t touch long positions in ETH below 1,850. Don’t touch naked long positions in BTC below 64,000. Don’t chase longs on a pullback after SOL breaks 80. Don’t chase upside after HYPE news hype develops.

【Watch Tomorrow】
Whether BTC spot can close above 64,800 to confirm the short-term direction. Whether CEX BTC inventory continues to rise. ETH’s gains/losses around 1,855. Whether SOL on-chain trading volume can recover. The long/short standoff data before the chip earnings report needs updating.

BTC：全场方向锚定在 64,645 一线，这是短期生命线。上方 65,000 是空头最后防线，小时线实体收上去才算突破。下方 63,500 是吸筹区，有效跌破会直接考验 62,000。今天有两个事实同时成立：反弹由真实 Taker 买盘驱动，长短期持仓比创下 30 个月新高，这在历史上通常出现在重新积累阶段。但币安 BTC 存量大增，UTXO 亏损比率也走到了极端水平。这种情况以前只出现在熊市深度压力期，所以追多没有性价比。我会等 64,800-65,000 的突破确认，或者等日线回踩 63,500 再动手。63,500 失守，就全面防御。

ETH：主流里最弱的一环。近 12 小时内巨鲸在 1,858 附近市价加仓做空，多头只剩 1,800 整数关的被动防守，缺乏主动买入资金。链上 Gas 极低，生态活跃度萎缩是事实。如果 BTC 去测试 65,000，ETH 最多被动跟到 1,900-1,920，我不会去追。跌破 1,855 且无力收回，ETH 就是优先规避的对象。

SOL：链上热度下降非常明显，Meme 和新盘的资金正在干涸。价格被压在 80 心理关口之下，做多力量几乎消失。HYPE 的 上市 叙事分流了大部分注意力，如果这个叙事不能持续输入资金，SOL 链上的流动性将面临短期枯竭。我个人会在 SOL 有效站上 80.5 之后，再考虑配置它的生态代币，现在只看不动。

HYPE：因 上市前 合约上线，捕获了短期的注意力。链上多空比已经高达 1.88，高位获利盘随时可能出逃，追高性价比极差。这个位置只适合早期介入的人设移动止盈博后续，不是新开的时机。

BABA：阿里旗下 AI 整合进苹果中国生态，短期情绪提振。但 AI 变现路径长，实体业务也受宏观增速约束，只能当作 AI 落地的风向标观察，个人不入仓。

【今天不追】
不碰 ETH 在 1,850 下方的多单。不碰 64,000 下方的 BTC 裸多。不碰 SOL 突破 80 的回踩追多。不碰 HYPE 消息发酵后的追高。

BTC 实体能不能收上 64,800，确认短期方向。CEX 的 BTC 存量是否继续攀升。ETH 在 1,855 的得失。SOL 链上交易量能否修复。芯片财报前的多空对赌数据需要更新。

title: The Goal Is Not to Be Right Every Time.
subTitle:
One of the biggest myths in investing is that successful investors are always right. They're not. Even the best investors make mistakes. The difference is that they don't let one mistake define their future.
They accept losses. They learn from them. They adjust when new evidence appears. And they protect their capital so they can invest another day. Experienced investors understand: Investing is not a game of perfection. It's a game of discipline, adaptation, and continuous learning.
🔑 Key Takeaway: You don't need to win every decision. You need to make decisions that keep you in the game long enough for good judgment to compound.
🧠 Practical Reflection; Before making your next investment, ask yourself: If I'm wrong, will this mistake teach me or permanently damage my ability to continue investing? The goal is not to avoid every mistake. The goal is to make mistakes you can recover from.
Systems over emotion. Conviction over noise.

Frequent switching of trading cycles is an invisible killer that makes beginners get more confused and lose more money the more they trade.
Most people don’t lose because their direction is wrong—they lose because their thinking is chaotic and their standards are inconsistent. One moment they look at short-term moves, the next they chase the trend; they keep switching the rhythm back and forth, and all decisions are made by instinct.
With a 1500U account, a beginner made two wins on short-term trades, then became greedy and switched to holding positions based on the trend. But they couldn’t hold the position: when it went up a little they panicked, and when it dipped they were afraid. They kept flipping between long and short, switching cycles repeatedly. In the end, after paying fees and taking losses, they wiped out a full 1000U. Without a fixed trading system, every trade becomes blind gambling.
People who profit long-term keep their trading cycle fixed. They never turn short-term trades into long-term holds, and they don’t enter and exit frequently on trend trades. Stick only to your own trading system—don’t let emotions from the market pull you off course.
My iron rule: one fixed trading cycle only; no overnight holding for short-term trades; and for trend trades, don’t frequently “tinker” with rapid T+0 behavior. You don’t need to be good at everything in trading—you only need to execute one set of rules all the way through. Not trading recklessly is the highest level of risk control.
Right now the market rhythm is chaotic, with frequent cycle switching. Switching your thinking randomly makes it easy to suffer consecutive losses. I only share grounded, simple trading logic that can keep you safe—no hype. Feel free to follow.

title: 做外贸赚到80万，却在币圈学会第一课：别把经验当优势
subTitle: 很多做生意的人进入币圈，都会犯一个共同的错误：把以前成功的经验直接复制到市场里。觉得自己看过行业周期，懂供需变化，判断趋势应该不会差。但市场不会因为你过去赚过钱，就给你特殊待遇。今天分享一个粉丝投稿故事，一个外贸老板，从实体生意走进币圈，赚到过，也被市场狠狠教育过。 这位粉丝年轻时一直做外贸，从跑市场、找客户开始，一步步把生意做起来。经历过行业红利，也经历过订单减少、竞争加剧的时候。他最大的感受就是：实体行业赚钱越来越依靠资源和效率，单靠一门生意，很难保持长期增长。 几年前一次和国外客户聊天时，对方聊到了BTC和数字资产。当时他发现，海外市场已经有不少人在讨论区块链和未来金融方向。出于好奇，他开始研究这个新领域。 从最开始不知道钱包是什么，到学习交易所操作，再到研究市场周期、资金流向，他花了大量时间去了解这个市场。 他进入币圈之前，靠多年外贸经营积累了80万左右资金。真正进入市场后，他没有盲目追热点，而是结合自己做生意多年的经验，开始观察市场周期。 在一轮行情启动前，他提前布局BTC、ETH，同时关注一些新兴生态赛道。随着市场上涨，账户资金也迎来增长。 那段时间，他觉得自己的商业判断能力终于找到了新的用武之地。因为做外贸的时候，他习惯观察市场需求变化，判断行业趋势，所以他认为交易应该也是一样。 但真正的问题，出现在赚钱之后。 赚到钱以后，他开始尝试短线合约，希望提高资金效率。刚开始几次交易非常顺利，连续盈利让他的信心不断增加，仓位也越来越大胆。 他当时的想法很简单：“做生意这么多年，大方向我都能判断，交易应该也不会差。” 可市场很快给了他一课。 一次行情突然反转，价格快速下跌，他原本判断只是短期调整，所以没有及时降低仓位。等发现趋势已经改变时，之前积累的利润已经回撤了一大部分。 那一次之后，他才明白一个道理：做生意靠的是判断机会，而交易除了判断机会，更重要的是控制风险。 生意里库存压错了，可以慢慢消化；但交易里的仓位错了，市场可能不给你等待的时间。 后来他的交易方式开始改变，不再每天追涨杀跌，而是把币圈定位成资产配置的一部分。实体业务负责创造现金流，投资负责寻找长期增长机会，两者形成互补。 他说现在最大的变化，是以前看到机会就想抓住，现在看到机会会先问自己三个问题：方向对不对？仓位能不能承受？如果判断错了，退出方案在哪里？ 很多人进入市场，总觉得自己缺少机会。其实机会一直存在，真正困难的是，当机会出现的时候，你有没有足够的认知和纪律去接住。 商业经验可以帮助你发现趋势，但市场规则决定你能不能留下收益。交易不是比谁更聪明，而是比谁能控制风险，比谁能在错误发生后及时调整。 如果你也在币圈寻找自己的交易节奏，想和更多长期研究市场的人一起交流，可以加入我的战队，一起复盘行情，一起提升交易认知。市场永远有机会，但真正留下来的，永远是懂规则的人。$LAB $ETH $BTC #ETH #BTC #LAB #ZEC #DOGE

translatedData.title: Made 800,000 by doing foreign trade, yet learned the first lesson in crypto: don’t treat experience as an advantage
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people who do business enter the crypto market and make a common mistake: they copy their previous successful experience directly into the market. They think that because they’ve seen industry cycles before, understand supply and demand changes, and can judge trends, things shouldn’t turn out too badly. But the market won’t give you special treatment just because you made money in the past. Today I’m sharing a story submitted by a fan: a foreign trade boss who went from offline business into crypto, made money, and was taught a painful lesson by the market. 

This fan was young and had been doing foreign trade for years, starting from running around to find customers and build the business step by step. He experienced industry tailwinds, and also times when orders dropped and competition intensified. His biggest takeaway is: making money in the real economy increasingly depends on resources and efficiency. Relying on just one line of business makes it difficult to sustain long-term growth. 

A few years ago, during a conversation with an overseas client, the other person brought up BTC and digital assets. At that time, he realized that many people abroad were already discussing blockchain and the future of finance. Out of curiosity, he began studying this new field. 

From not even knowing what a wallet was at first, to learning how to operate on exchanges, to researching market cycles and capital flows—he spent a lot of time getting to know the market. 

Before entering crypto, based on years of foreign trade management he had accumulated around 800,000 RMB. After he truly entered the market, he didn’t blindly chase hot trends. Instead, drawing on his years of business experience, he started observing market cycles. 

Before a market rally kicked off, he laid out BTC and ETH early, while also keeping an eye on some emerging ecosystem sectors. As the market rose, his account balance also grew. 

During that period, he felt like his business judgment finally found a new place to shine. Because when doing foreign trade, he was used to observing changes in market demand and judging industry trends—so he believed trading should work the same way. 

But the real problem appeared after he started making money. 

After he made profits, he began trying short-term futures contracts to improve capital efficiency. At first, his trades went very smoothly. A streak of winning trades kept boosting his confidence, and his position size became bolder and bolder. 

At the time, his thinking was simple: “After doing business for so many years, I can judge the big direction. Trading shouldn’t be that different.” 

But the market quickly taught him a lesson. 

One time, the market suddenly reversed, and the price dropped rapidly. He had thought it was only a short-term correction, so he didn’t reduce his position in time. By the time he realized the trend had changed, a large portion of the profits he had built up was already gone. 

Only after that did he understand a key principle: in business, you rely on judging opportunities; in trading, besides judging opportunities, controlling risk is even more important. 

If you mismanage inventory in business, you can slowly digest it; but if your position in trading is wrong, the market may not give you the time to wait. 

Later, his trading approach began to change. He stopped chasing pumps and dumps every day. Instead, he treated crypto as a part of asset allocation. His real business was responsible for creating cash flow, while investing was about finding long-term growth opportunities—together they complement each other. 

He said the biggest change now is that before, when he saw an opportunity, he wanted to grab it immediately. Now, when he sees an opportunity, he asks himself three questions first: Is the direction correct? Can the position size be handled? If his judgment is wrong, what’s the exit plan? 

Many people enter the market and always feel like they lack opportunities. Actually, opportunities are always there. The real difficulty is: when an opportunity appears, do you have enough understanding and discipline to catch it? 

Business experience can help you spot trends, but market rules determine whether you can stay long enough to keep your gains. Trading isn’t about who’s smarter—it’s about who can control risk, and who can adjust in time when things go wrong. 

If you’re also looking for your own trading rhythm in the crypto market and want to exchange ideas with more people who study the market long-term, you can join my team—to review market moves together and improve your trading understanding. The market always has opportunities, but what truly remains is always for those who understand the rules.$LAB $ETH $BTC #ETH #BTC #LAB #ZEC #DOGE

Babies! I made over 2 million this year, but honestly, it’s not that I’m so awesome—it’s because I’ve taken enough losses that I finally learned how to survive in the crypto market. You have to stay up late; you can’t not.

Don’t tell me anything about “crypto freedom” or “easy mode.” Real market action all happens during the working hours of people in Europe and the US.
Last year, for three months, I went to sleep at 8 p.m. every night and got up at 3 a.m., living like a vampire—but it was worth it.
$ETH : the third wave of an early-morning surge—just catching one push is 30%+ casually. If you don’t watch the charts, you don’t even have the right to see the excitement.

Big drops in the daytime? Don’t panic—that’s an opportunity. The Asian-session crash is basically a scam meant to get you to cut losses.
The harshest time was last July: during the day, BTC got smashed to 59,000. The whole internet was singing the bearish tune. I turned around and put in buy orders at 58,500; that night it directly pumped to 63,000.

You need to know: the more painfully Asia cries, the more violently the foreigners pump at night. The longer the needle, the bigger the opportunity.

You think those 15% “needle” wicks happen by accident? That’s the market maker’s way of washing people out.
$SOL : last time, after that 125-point needle pierced, the price doubled within two days.
Real market conditions are never gentle—only ruthless. Once you panic, you get hooked.
Good news is when you should run.
Back in June last year with the ETF wave: BTC pumped about 7 days early. The moment the news landed, I cleared out my position and went short right away. The next day it crashed by 10%.

In crypto, it’s not about fundamentals—it’s about whether expectations get fulfilled. As soon as the news comes out, it’s the time to “sell the fact.”
Heavy bags have no future. For the people going All in, half of them are lining up to the execution grounds. My position in any single trade never exceeds 5%. Some people think I’m slow—I think it’s steady.
If you can stay alive, then you’re qualified to talk about making money.
The most profitable thing in crypto isn’t technical skill—it’s discipline.
It’s not about how accurate you are—it’s whether you can control yourself.
Being able to run, endure, and wait—that’s the basic quality of a top-tier player.
To put it plainly: the market is meant to be used for trading, not for dying with.
If you can’t take it in, then wait to be taught a lesson.

结合 4 小时 K 线结构与 24 小时清算热力图来看 $ETH 沿短期红色上升通道持续震荡反弹，昨日放量突破 1830 关键压力位，盘中最高触及 1890 一线，当前在 1870 附近高位整理，短期多头趋势延续性较强。

从清算热力图可直观验证，本轮拉升属于典型的空头清算踩踏行情：价格向上精准击穿 1850-1880 区间的密集空头清算带，大量空单被集中触发止损，形成连锁式推升，也是本次价格快速冲高的核心直接驱动力。

趋势结构与资金逻辑拆解

清算资金逻辑
从热力图的资金分布来看：上方 1900 整数关口附近仍留存一层较强的空头清算盘，是短期多头的下一个潜在攻击目标；下方 1830-1850 区间已由压力转换为支撑，叠加该位置是前期多空清算密集成交区，价格回踩后会有较强的多头承接力，是短期强弱分水岭。

中期趋势定性
本轮反弹本质是技术性修复 + 空头清算推动，尚未出现机构长线资金大规模建仓的信号，中期调整的大周期并未彻底反转，不可因单日冲高就盲目切换单边牛市思维。

U.S. June CPI falls to 3.5%, below market expectations 
Don’t rush to treat this CPI as a signal of a trend reversal. In June, the U.S. CPI year over year was 3.5%, lower than market expectations. The month-over-month figure also came in at -0.4%, marking the first negative growth in nearly six years. After the release, the market quickly shifted into an “rate-cut trade” mode: the U.S. dollar weakened, Treasury yields fell, risk assets rebounded across the board, and BTC surged to above 65,000. ETH followed suit and strengthened as well

But I believe the greatest value of this data lies in improving market sentiment—not changing market logic

The reason is simple: CPI is a lagging indicator. It reflects what happened over the past month, while capital markets are always pricing the future

Meanwhile, the Fed officials’ remarks were not as dovish as the market had imagined. On inflation, they remain highly vigilant. If subsequent data shows fluctuations, expectations for further rate hikes could easily heat up again. In other words, an upside CPI surprise alone is not enough to force a complete pivot in monetary policy

So, my outlook for the road ahead comes in two stages

In the short term, I remain cautiously bullish

After BTC breaks above 65,000, as long as it can hold effectively, there’s potential to challenge 68,000—and even higher. The essence of this rally is that risk appetite is being repaired as liquidity expectations improve. As long as sentiment hasn’t cooled, the market still has motivation to push higher

But over the medium to long term, I remain cautious to bearish

Right now, the biggest variable isn’t CPI anymore—it’s energy prices and geopolitics. If oil prices continue rising, inflation could quickly resurface. The market would then rapidly start pricing expectations that the Fed will delay rate cuts even further—or tighten policy again. At that point, the optimism today could reverse quickly

Therefore, I’m more willing to define this rally as a “expectations-repair” move rather than the restart of a bull market. While there is still room above 65,000, the higher it goes, the worse the risk-reward ratio becomes. At this stage, you can follow the trend and stay bullish—but it’s not advisable to chase gains blindly based on a single data release. What ultimately determines the direction may not be today’s CPI, but whether inflation will return in the coming months

There will still be many uncertainties ahead. We just need to wait for clarity to arrive
#btc #ETH #2026足球风潮

content:
美国6月CPI降至3.5%，低于市场预期 
先别急着把这份CPI当成趋势反转的信号，美国6月CPI同比3.5%，低于市场预期，环比更是录得-0.4%，创下近六年来首次负增长。数据公布后，市场迅速进入”降息交易”模式：美元走弱、美债收益率回落，风险资产全面反弹，BTC一举站上65000，ETH也同步走强

但我认为，这份数据最大的价值在于改善了市场情绪，而不是改变了市场逻辑

原因很简单，CPI是滞后指标，它反映的是过去一个月发生的事情，而资本市场永远在交易未来

与此同时，美联储官员的表态也没有市场想象中那么鸽派，对于通胀，他们依然保持高度警惕，如果后续数据出现反复，加息预期完全有可能重新升温。也就是说，一份超预期的CPI，并不足以让货币政策彻底转向

因此，我对后市的看法分为两个阶段

短期来看，我依然偏多

BTC突破65000之后，只要能够有效站稳，继续挑战68000甚至更高的位置都有可能，这轮上涨本质上是流动性预期改善带来的风险偏好修复，在情绪没有降温之前，市场还有继续冲高的动力

但中长期，我保持谨慎偏空

目前最大的变量已经不是CPI，而是能源价格和地缘政治一旦油价继续上涨，未来通胀重新抬头，市场很快就会重新交易美联储延后降息甚至再次收紧政策的预期，届时现在的乐观情绪可能迅速逆转

所以，我更愿意把这一轮上涨定义为预期修复行情，而不是牛市重新启动，65000上方确实还有空间，但越往上，风险收益比越差，现阶段可以顺势看多，但不建议因为一份数据就盲目追高，真正决定行情方向的，或许不是今天的CPI，而是未来几个月通胀是否会卷土重来
未来还是有很多的不确定性，我们只需要等待确定性到来就可以了

GENIUS Act · Angle: July 18 deadline for the stablecoin regulations—who wins and who loses
On July 18, U.S. regulators must turn the GENIUS Act into a set of concrete rules, determining which stablecoin issuers can operate in the United States. The deadline is still four days away.
Mizuho downgraded Circle to underperform the market, partly because a competitor, Open USD, has launched, which is expected to weigh on Circle’s mid-term profitability. The logic behind this is that once the GENIUS Act is implemented, it will impose bank-level KYC requirements. For large issuers with a compliance foundation, it becomes a moat; for smaller players, it becomes a barrier—but it also creates opportunities for new compliant competitors to enter.
After the regulatory framework takes effect, the stablecoin market will likely split—those that obtain the necessary compliance approvals stay, while those that don’t either exit the U.S. market or shift to other jurisdictions. Both Circle’s USDC and Tether’s USDT face this framework. Being big doesn’t automatically mean they can pass smoothly; what matters is the specific details of how the KYC standards are implemented.
The market landscape in this sector four days from now will directly affect how stablecoin liquidity is distributed on-chain, which in turn influences DeFi protocol TVL and fee revenue. Watching stablecoin regulation is essentially watching the very top of the entire DeFi pipeline.
Which stablecoins do you currently hold? How do you think the landscape will change after the GENIUS Act? Let’s discuss in the comments.

Macroeconomic background
Last night, the U.S. June CPI came in broadly below expectations across the board (YoY core: 2.6%; MoM: -0.4%). Rate-cut expectations surged noticeably, directly pushing BTC from 62,000 to above 64,700, and ETH from 1,779 to around 1,890. However, note that this rally is mainly driven by the news. Overbought conditions are clearly evident in the short term. Three major events this evening (Williams’s remarks, the Bank of Canada rate decision, and the Powell/Watts hearing) will determine whether the uptrend continues or a pullback correction occurs.

BTC
The daily MACD golden cross continues. The medium-term bullish structure remains unchanged, but the 14-day RSI hit 76, placing it in the severe overbought zone—chasing is high risk. After a sequence of consecutive bullish candles on the 4-hour chart, a doji appeared, suggesting clear selling pressure around 65,000. Support is the first zone at 63,800–64,200, the consolidation range before the breakout last night. If it breaks, look for 63,000–63,300. Resistance is 65,000–65,300, the prior high and a dense order/position area. Only an effective breakout can open room toward 66,000–66,800.

ETH
ETH’s rebound has been stronger than BTC’s, mainly benefiting from oversold repair. But 1,900–1,935 is the previous M-head-and-shoulders neckline area, where trapped positions are heavy, making a one-shot breakout extremely difficult. The 4-hour RSI is also overbought, and there is a near-term need for a pullback toward 1,840–1,860. Support is 1,820–1,840 (moving-average support band). If it breaks, look for 1,760–1,780.

BTC range strategy
Longs: Buy on pullback 64,000–64,300 after stabilization. Stop-loss: below 63,700. Targets: 64,900–65,200. If it breaks above 65,300, you can hold for around 66,000.

Shorts: On a rebound 65,000–65,300 that stalls, enter with a light position. Stop-loss: 65,600. Targets: 64,200–63,900 (only betting on a correction; strict stop-loss required).

Breakout tracking: If it holds above 65,300 on rising volume, you can lightly chase longs. Stop-loss: 64,800. Targets: 66,000–66,800.

ETH strategy
Longs: Buy on pullback 1,840–1,860 after stabilization. Stop-loss: below 1,810. Targets: 1,900–1,930. A break above 1,930 can open a move toward 1,980.

Shorts: Enter on rebound 1,890–1,910 with a light position. Stop-loss: above 1,930. Targets: 1,840–1,820 (a breakout with volume above 1,930 makes the short idea invalid).

Risk warnings
· If the remarks tonight are more hawkish than expected, longs must cut losses immediately; if dovish, shorts must exit decisively.
· Geopolitics (U.S.-Iran conflict) may cause energy price swings, indirectly affecting inflation expectations.
· Leverage should be within 3x; keep loss per trade within 1% of total capital. If you hit stop-loss twice in a row, stop trading for the day.
#BTC #ETH

大饼区间策略

空单：反弹 65,000-65,300 滞涨轻仓入场，止损 65,600，目标 64,200-63,900（仅博弈回调，严格止损）。
突破追踪：若放量站稳65,300，可轻仓追多，止损64,800，目标66,000-66,800。

二饼策略

空单：反弹 1,890-1,910 轻仓入场，止损 1,930 上方，目标 1,840-1,820（放量突破1,930则空单失效）。

风险提示
· 晚间讲话若超预期鹰派，多单务必止损；若鸽派，空单需果断离场。

Don’t think about “holding on a bit more,” and don’t expect it to turn back.

When the market’s not cooperating, the more you trade, the more you lose your head.

The only times you truly get big meat is after the direction becomes clear.
When there’s no direction, I’d rather stare at the chart in silence than reach out randomly.

Fifth, your position size must never exceed 10% of your principal.
With a light position, you can hold your nerve.
If you go all-in, even a normal small fluctuation will shatter your mindset.

Crypto isn’t about who can charge the fastest.

【$BTC $ETH  Main Activity Tracking: Prices are rising but Takers are selling—who’s taking the other side】

#行情分析 #合约数据 #BTC #ETH

The overall market continues its rebound today. $BTC  is at 64648, up 2.84% over 24h; $ETH  is at 1879, up 4.48%. Both have hit recent highs. BTC briefly touched 65260, and ETH tested 1896. But there are a few signals in the derivatives data worth noting.

In terms of funding rates, BTC is currently at 0.00964% and ETH at only 0.00330%—neither is high. This suggests the market isn’t overheated overall, and bullish sentiment is relatively restrained.

Large-holder positioning is net long: BTC’s long/short ratio is 1.49 (59.88% long vs 40.12% short), and ETH’s is 1.23 (55.20% long vs 44.80% short). At the large account level, the long/short ratios are 1.37 and 1.35 respectively. Overall, it leans long but isn’t extreme.

What’s most worth watching is Taker trade data. BTC’s Taker buy/sell ratio is only 0.735, meaning the actively sold volume is far greater than actively bought volume. With prices rising but Takers selling, there are usually two explanations: (1) passive fills from limit buy orders propping up lower prices, while active sell orders take profit at higher levels; (2) the main players are pumping to distribute inventory. Taking into account that funding isn’t high and OI hasn’t expanded significantly, the former scenario seems more likely right now—retail and institutional profit-taking is gradually coming off.

ETH’s Taker ratio is 0.947, which is relatively balanced, and its pacing looks healthier than BTC’s.

After BTC met resistance above 65000, it pulled back slightly. If it can hold the 64000 level, the near-term bias remains somewhat bullish. If it breaks down—and the Taker ratio continues to skew bearish—then investors should be cautious about concentrated profit-taking flowing out. In the coming days, focus on changes in the Taker ratio: this metric can reflect market sentiment earlier than price itself.

Ethereum Institutional Privacy Layer Team Formally Establishes a Profit-Making Company EthSystems

Before institutional funds enter a public chain, they must first clear the privacy hurdle—this judgment in itself is nothing new. But this time, separating the team from the Ethereum Foundation ecosystem to set up a profit-making company signals something completely different. In the past, most privacy-layer R&D was carried out under non-profit organizations or academic projects, with slow progress and weak willingness to reach real-world deployment. Now, with EthSystems bringing in backing from Bitmine and Joe Lubin, it’s essentially installing a commercialized engine for the institutional privacy track. The question is: is this engine already firing up?

Watching the price action of $ETH is especially interesting. After the news broke, the current price of $ETH is $1,879, with a 24-hour increase of 4.55%. While that outperforms most major coins, it still sits about 62% below the all-time high of $4,946. This bigger move is more likely a follow-through from a broader market rebound rather than a targeted repricing of this specific piece of news—after all, it still takes time for the privacy layer to land on the mainnet, and the market won’t instantly award an Ethereum premium just because a team became independent.

What’s truly worth monitoring is what comes next: Will EthSystems issue its own token? Will it directly interact with Ethereum mainnet L2s or privacy protocols? If it’s only a team restructuring without a concrete product roadmap, this wave of sentiment likely won’t last more than three days.

From a mechanism standpoint, this news is more like “institutional-side infrastructure” rather than a “retail FOMO” target. Bitmine and Lubin’s endorsements imply that capital is already betting on compliant privacy solutions—but institutional entry usually moves slowly. They need to first assess regulatory stance, then technical audits, and only then dare to commit real money. So short-term traders shouldn’t expect $ETH to carve out an “independent” breakout solely because of this. However, from a mid-term perspective, if EthSystems launches a testnet within three months or reaches a partnership with a custodian, the narrative around institutional adoption of Ethereum could be reactivated.

The validation conditions are clear. First, see whether $ETH can increase volume and hold above $1,900—that’s near the 24-hour high and also the dense recent-positions area. Second, watch whether EthSystems’ official channels publish details about tokenomics or list their partner(s). If a top-tier exchange or a compliant custodian is involved, the privacy-layer concept could spread from Ethereum to the entire L2 ecosystem. Third, if the news cycle turns quiet afterward, $ETH will likely retest the $1,800 support area—then would be the window to observe whether institutions are truly accumulating at low levels.

Don’t treat this news as an independent catalyst for Ethereum. It’s more like a signal flare, lighting up the privacy tracks that must be laid before institutional funds can enter public chains. Once the track is laid, the train will come.

机构资金进公链前必须先过隐私关——这个判断本身并不新鲜，但这次把团队从以太坊基金会体系里独立出来成立营利公司，意味就完全不同了。过去这类隐私层研发大多挂在非营利组织或学术项目下，进展慢、落地意愿弱；现在EthSystems拉来Bitmine和Joe Lubin的站台，等于给机构隐私赛道装了一个商业化的引擎。问题是，这个引擎现在点火了吗？

看$ETH的盘面反应就很有意思。新闻发出后，$ETH现价1879美元，24小时涨幅4.55%，虽然跑赢了多数主流币，但距离历史最高点4946美元仍有62%的回撤。这个涨幅更大概率是跟随大盘反弹，而非对这条消息的定向定价——毕竟隐私层落地到主网还需要时间，市场不会因为一个团队独立就立刻给以太坊溢价。真正值得盯的是后续：EthSystems会不会发行自己的代币？会不会与以太坊主网的L2或隐私协议产生直接交互？如果只是团队重组而没有具体产品路线图，那这轮情绪撑不过三天。

从机制上看，这条消息更偏向「机构侧基建」而非「散户FOMO标的」。Bitmine和Lubin的背书意味着资金方已经在押注合规隐私方案，但机构入场的节奏向来慢——他们需要先看监管态度、再看技术审计、最后才敢把真金白银放进去。所以短线交易者别指望$ETH因此走出独立行情，但中线视角下，如果EthSystems在三个月内推出测试网或与某家托管商达成合作，那以太坊的机构采用叙事会重新被激活。

验证条件很清晰：第一，看$ETH能否放量站稳1900美元，这是24小时高点附近，也是近期筹码密集区；第二，关注EthSystems官方渠道是否公布代币经济或合作方名单，如果有头部交易所或合规托管商入局，隐私层概念会从以太坊扩散到整个L2生态；第三，如果后续消息面真空，$ETH大概率回踩1800美元支撑，那时才是观察机构是否真正在低位吸筹的窗口。

别把这条新闻当成以太坊的独立催化剂——它更像一个信号弹，照亮的是机构资金进入公链前必须铺设的隐私轨道。轨道铺好了，车才会来。

title: ​🚨 ¿XRP y Ethereum en peligro? Ojo a esta señal contradictoria 🚨
subTitle:
​¡Hola, comunidad! Hoy quiero que analicemos un dato sumamente interesante que está pasando desapercibido para la mayoría, pero que en el análisis técnico e institucional lo es todo.
​Seguramente han visto que tanto Ethereum ($ETH) como XRP ($XRP) han estado en boca de todos en redes sociales. El optimismo abunda, pero... ¿es esto realmente una buena señal? 🤔
​📉 El "Peligro" del Sentimiento Contrario
​Históricamente, cuando la masa se pone extremadamente eufórica en redes sociales durante una consolidación, el mercado suele hacer lo contrario. Los datos de Santiment revelan que el optimismo social está por las nubes (con XRP registrando más de 3 comentarios alcistas por cada bajista). Esto en teoría nos da una señal bajista por exceso de confianza. 
​Sin embargo, aquí viene el detalle clave que separa a ambos activos: 
​⚡ La gran diferencia: Tasas de Financiación (Funding Rates)
​Ethereum (Alineado): En ETH, tanto el sentimiento social como los traders de derivados van en la misma dirección. Las tasas de financiación siguen siendo positivas, lo que muestra un consenso alcista más orgánico (aunque con riesgo de liquidación si el precio retrocede abruptamente).
​XRP (En la cuerda floja): ¡Aquí está la anomalía! Mientras en redes sociales todo el mundo celebra, la tasa de financiación de XRP se ha vuelto negativa. Esto significa que los traders profesionales y apalancados están abriendo cortos con fuerza, apostando en contra del optimismo minorista.
​💡 Mi sugerencia de observación
​Cuando la masa va hacia un lado y los derivados apuestan al otro, la volatilidad está garantizada. Si los osos ganan la batalla en derivados, XRP podría sufrir un retroceso notable. Pero si el impulso de compra minorista y el volumen spot son lo suficientemente fuertes, podríamos ver un short squeeze que liquide a los bajistas.
​¡Mucho ojo con operar con apalancamiento en estas zonas de conflicto!
​¿Ustedes qué opinan? ¿Se alinean con el optimismo de las redes o creen que los traders de cortos tienen la razón en XRP? ¡Los leo en los comentarios! 👇
​Disclaimer: Este análisis es meramente informativo y no constituye asesoramiento financiero. Realiza siempre tu propia investigación (DYOR).

🇰🇷 South Korea’s KOSPI tanked today—then crypto trading volume exploded

Today, South Korea’s KOSPI Composite Index fell sharply, hitting a new recent low.

Meanwhile, trading volumes across major South Korean crypto exchanges showed a clear abnormal spike.

This isn’t the first time this pattern has appeared.

South Korea is one of the world’s most unique crypto markets:

• Retail participation is extremely high—Asia’s #1 in average crypto holdings
• Whenever the stock market takes a big hit, the won weakens, or economic data disappoints, funds quickly flow into crypto
• This phenomenon even has a specific term: “Kimchi Premium” (kimchi premium)—crypto prices locally in South Korea are higher than international prices

The logic behind it is pretty simple:

When both the local stock market and the currency face problems, crypto becomes the fastest and lowest-barrier alternative asset.

In a globalized context, economic turbulence in a country can affect global crypto capital flows in unexpected ways.

My take: this isn’t a full retreat from risk assets; it’s more like taking profits on semiconductors that had run too far, then rotating toward earnings certainty and less crowded directions. VIX is about 15.9, down 7.3% on the day. For now, there’s no sign of panic-driven selloff.

【Crypto: followed the early pullback, but BTC is more resilient】
BTC is about $65,340, up 2.34% over 24 hours; ETH about $1,929, up 3.48% over 24 hours. Based on the US stock open, BTC is about +0.2% and ETH about -0.2%. Both dipped roughly 20 minutes after the open: BTC’s low was 64,888 and ETH’s low was 1,917, then they repaired—suggesting they did follow the risk-on cooling after the US stock open, but BTC recovered faster.

The crypto mirror to US stocks is also quite split: IBIT is up 1.16% versus the prior close and MSTR up 7.56%, but MARA is -2.59% and RIOT -1.51%. This isn’t a broad launch for miner stocks and high-beta names; instead, capital is more skewed toward spot ETFs and core assets.

【News interpretation】
1) US June PPI: -0.3% month-over-month; core only +0.1%. That’s supportive for valuations in the near term. But PPI year-over-year is 5.5% and core year-over-year 5.1%, meaning inflation stickiness hasn’t fully gone away. So the positive impact looks more like “a breath of relief” rather than a one-way rate-cut trade.
2) Q2 earnings at large banks generally beat expectations. Trading and investment banking business are strong, directly supporting financials and reinforcing the narrative that the US economy still has resilience.
3) The US has re-blocked Iranian ports and increased strikes, pushing Hol­­muz risk back up. Oil prices remain elevated, but energy stocks are weaker intraday and the VIX is falling—indicating the stock market is not currently pricing in a full upgrade. Ironically, this could be the key news risk to watch into the close.

【Close outlook and overnight implications】
The baseline scenario is a slightly strong close with consolidation: the S&P and Dow should be steadier, while the Nasdaq retains most of its gap-up gains but may not be able to surge further in a one-direction move. As long as the S&P holds 7,557 and the Nasdaq holds 26,173, there’s still a chance of a pullback/capital return late in the session. YOUR $ETH LONG DIES FOR AN ALT SHORT: CROSS MARGIN ON $GRVT 🔥

In cross margin, every position shares one book. When your Cross Margin Ratio hits 100%, GRVT closes everything — not just the loser. Your winning ETH long gets liquidated because your alt short went bad. One book, one funeral.

Isolated flips it: each position has its own collateral. But the docs hide a one-way ratchet — once you're in, you can increase leverage but never decrease it. You can add margin to walk the liq price away, but the leverage dial only turns up.

Six years in, I switch by regime: cross for trending markets, isolated for chop. Which side of the wall do you trade from?
